meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: Spatial statements, including RRBs, March 2004 to March 2017
meta.coverage: Bank offices by the size of their deposits or credit, by bank group and population group (statements 6A and 6B), every quarter from March 2004 to March 2017, including regional rural banks
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1489 (data provider DP0), with report 1488 for the dates it alone carries (shared rows agree), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (9 values, e.g. Foreign banks, Metropolitan, offices ranked by deposit, size class 0-2.50 (₹ crore, as printed), population groups by the 2001 census, their credit on 2012-03-01; Foreign banks, Metropolitan, offices ranked by deposit, size class 0-2.50 (₹ crore, as printed), population groups by the 2001 census, their credit on 2014-03-01; Foreign banks, Metropolitan, offices ranked by deposit, size class 0-2.50 (₹ crore, as printed), population groups by the 2001 census, their deposits on 2015-03-01).
